usage_boundary: Adapt roles, authority, risk policy, retention rules and applicable legal requirements before production use. These are not legal forms or accredited certification records.

templates.name: Store Inspection Closure Tracker

workflow.name: Detect and classify
workflow.exit_criterion: Deviation and provisional risk level recorded

workflow.name: Capture evidence
workflow.exit_criterion: Location, time, standard reference and field proof attached

workflow.name: Assign owner and deadline
workflow.exit_criterion: One accountable owner accepts an organization-defined deadline

workflow.name: Contain immediate risk
workflow.exit_criterion: Unsafe or material exposure is controlled before normal operation continues

workflow.name: Verify effectiveness
workflow.exit_criterion: Assigned verifier confirms the acceptance criterion in the field

workflow.name: Analyze recurrence and prevent
workflow.exit_criterion: Recurring or systemic issues trigger root-cause and system action

decision_rules: Use one record per issue. Name the action performer, accountable owner, assigned verifier and closure approver; record evidence references without exposing personal or confidential information.
Keep the issue open until the agreed acceptance criterion is met and the assigned verifier records field evidence. A correction photo alone does not establish effectiveness.

Record verification result as pass, fail or pending. Record closure decision as open, closed, rejected, escalated or reopened. Close only after a pass, evidence and dated approval; failed or missing verification cannot be closed.
The verifier should not verify their own corrective action. If staffing prevents separation, obtain an independent authorized review and document the exception before closure.

For repeated findings, link the original issue, reopen it or create a linked issue under local policy, and assign root cause, preventive action, owner, due date and effectiveness review. A closed correction does not mean prevention is complete.
